skills.name: Gateway: Chat Completions
skills.description: POST /v1/chat/completions (also /api/v1/chat/completions): OpenAI-shaped chat with SSE streaming and a full fallback pipeline. Accepts a real model id, auto, or auto:<profile>; the response model is always the requested id and the truth lives in _nova.

skills.name: Gateway: Anthropic Messages
skills.description: POST /v1/messages and POST /v1/messages/count_tokens in the Anthropic wire format, behind the same client-key auth. OpenAI providers are translated through nova/provider_transport.py; native passthrough is used when the upstream already speaks Anthropic.

skills.name: Gateway: Responses API
skills.description: POST /v1/responses translates the OpenAI Responses shape (input, instructions) onto the existing chat pipeline and streams response.created, then response.output_text.delta, to response.completed, or ends with response.failed.

skills.name: Gateway: Completions, Embeddings, Models
skills.description: POST /v1/completions (legacy text completion), POST /v1/embeddings (non-streaming vector output), and GET /v1/models, which lists every enabled model plus the auto, auto:<profile> and routerx/pro, routerx/air, routerx/mini virtual ids; ?discover=1 adds live upstream discovery.

skills.name: Client Keys
skills.description: Gateway credentials (nova-sk-...) managed from the Keys tab or /api/admin/client-keys. Each key can restrict allowed model globs, a sliding-minute RPM and a daily token budget; auth is fail-open on a fresh install and fail-closed once any enabled key exists (NOVA_REQUIRE_API_KEY forces keys).

skills.name: Rate Limits and Usage Caps
skills.description: Per provider, model and key usage booking through nova/ratelimit.py, with the rate_limits knob at GET and POST /api/admin/rate-limits (0 = unlimited, the default). GET /api/admin/usage reports how much of each window is spent and which (provider, model) pairs are exhausted.

skills.name: Providers and Upstream Keys
skills.description: Add, edit, test, sign in and delete provider connections from the Providers tab (/api/admin/providers). Each provider holds one or more upstream keys; keys rotate, cool down on 429/5xx honouring Retry-After, and can be cleared in bulk from /api/admin/keys/clear-cooldowns.

skills.name: Models Catalogue and Health Sweeps
skills.description: Browse, filter, enable or disable and ping every discovered model from the Models tab (/api/admin/models). Sync Catalogue refreshes the curated registry plus each provider live /models, and Disable Unreachable sweeps health so dead models stop competing for requests.

skills.name: Fallback Routes and Preview
skills.description: Define per-model fallback chains from the Routes tab (/api/admin/routes) and inspect the Stage 1/2/3 dispatch timeline before saving. At request time the gateway walks the direct upstream, then the explicit chain, then the RouterX Free engine, reporting every stage in _nova.routing.

skills.name: Routing Settings
skills.description: GET and POST /api/admin/routing configure the strategy, scoring weights, lockout tuning, policies, fallback chains and the model exposure allow/deny lists that nova/routing.py applies to every candidate pool. Lockout state is visible at /api/admin/routing/availability and can be cleared per pair or entirely.

skills.name: Routing Profiles
skills.description: Named chains requested as auto:<profile> (GET and POST /api/admin/routing/profiles, DELETE /api/admin/routing/profiles/{name}). A profile carries its own fallbacks, strategy and auto-standins flag; an unknown profile gets a 404 instead of a silent fallback.

skills.name: Routing Strategies and Scoring
skills.description: Selection strategies applied to an ordered candidate pool: priority, weighted, round-robin, random, least-used, cost-optimized, rules, cost, latency, sla and lkgp. nova/routing.py scores each candidate on health, reliability, latency, cost, quality and stability with weights you can tune in Routing Settings.

skills.name: Usage and Analytics
skills.description: The Analytics tab and GET /api/admin/analytics aggregate RequestLog rows into request volume, token usage, provider splits and p50/p95 latency plus time-to-first-token, with a date range and provider/model filters.

skills.name: Response Cache
skills.description: Opt-in content-addressed cache for non-streaming 200 responses without tool calls. Enable it with NOVA_RESPONSE_CACHE or the response_cache knob, bound it with a TTL/LRU policy, and inspect or purge it from GET /api/admin/cache/stats and POST /api/admin/cache/clear. OFF by default.

skills.name: Sticky Sessions
skills.description: Send x-nova-session (or metadata.session_id) to pin a conversation to the model that served it. nova/session.py reorders the candidate pool so the pinned model goes first, never dropping a fallback, and reports a _nova.handoff note when the pin had to move.

skills.name: Dashboard Tabs
skills.description: Eleven server-rendered HTMX tabs: overview, playground, console, providers, models, routes, keys, storage, analytics, logs and terminal. Each tab calls this app own JSON API through ui/api_client.py, so the dashboard always reflects the gateway.

skills.name: Playground
skills.description: A prompt sandbox at the Playground tab: pick a model, tweak the request, send it through POST /v1/chat/completions and read the streamed answer next to the _nova metadata showing which upstream actually answered.

skills.name: Console
skills.description: One chatbox with three modes: plain chat (streams from /api/v1/chat/completions), dollar-prefixed commands and slash diagnostics in the sandbox executor, and bang-prefixed goals or /agent goals that launch an autonomous agent task whose steps stream into the conversation. An MCP plugin drawer runs registered tools inline.

skills.name: Logs
skills.description: Every gateway call is written to RequestLog and browsable from the Logs tab (GET /api/admin/logs): filter by provider, model, status and time range, inspect latency, time-to-first-token and token usage, and follow one request by its x-request-id.

skills.name: MCP Plugins
skills.description: Register external MCP servers (streamable HTTP or stdio) from POST /api/admin/mcp/servers, then refresh and call their tools at /api/admin/mcp/servers/refresh and /servers/call. Tool calls go through nova/mcp_client.py, are scope-checked by nova/mcp_tools.py, and reach the agent as mcp_call.

skills.name: MCP Scopes and Tool Search
skills.description: GET /api/admin/mcp/scopes returns the least-privilege scope table and the tool-to-scope map. A credential that declares scopes only sees tools its scopes cover; no declared scopes means everything is permitted. The ReDoS-safe lexical search_tools() picks which plugin tools to surface to an agent.

skills.name: Agent Skill Catalogue
skills.description: GET /api/admin/skills serves the RouterX agent-skill catalogue (this list) with categories, areas and per-skill briefing prompts for the autonomous agent; a q query runs a substring search across id, name, description and area.

skills.name: Autonomous Agent
skills.description: POST /api/agent/tasks starts a plan, tool, step loop in nova/agent.py using web_search, read_url, terminal, gateway_stats, storage_scan, discover_models, the file tools, bash_exec and mcp_call. Steps are persisted as AgentStep rows, polled from GET /api/agent/tasks/{id}, and can be cancelled.

skills.name: Storage and Backups
skills.description: Connect Firebase, Supabase, S3/R2, B2 and other targets from the Storage tab (/api/admin/storage) to store files fetched by the agent or written to the workspace, and run one-shot backups from POST /api/admin/storage/backup.

skills.name: Compute (GPU) Providers
skills.description: GET /api/admin/compute/providers and POST /api/admin/compute/providers/{id}/toggle manage the free-GPU catalogue and its on/off state; GET and POST /api/admin/compute/config hold the compute settings the console surfaces.

skills.name: Terminal Workspace
skills.description: The Terminal tab (or the standalone /terminal page) runs a real PTY per session, max 8 and a 30-minute idle reap, with xterm.js tabs; the console dollar commands instead run in the simulated sandbox executor (allowlisted, no child processes, honest exit codes).

skills.name: RouterX Free Engine
skills.description: The built-in keyless engine: a bun/node sidecar (engine/index.js) spawned on loopback that serves routerx/pro, routerx/air, routerx/mini and auto from engine/free-models.json. It is the final fallback stage, needs no configuration, and degrades honestly when no free upstream answers.

skills.name: Cooldowns and Lockouts
skills.description: Upstream keys cool down on rate limits and provider faults, and (provider, model) pairs lock out after repeated failures with exponential backoff. Watch both from GET /api/admin/routing/availability and the overview badges, and recover a provider with Clear Cooldowns or by clearing a lockout.

skills.name: Deployment and Health
skills.description: One FastAPI process on 0.0.0.0:PORT (default 3000) serves the gateway API, the admin and agent JSON APIs and the dashboard; the engine sidecar runs on NOVA_ENGINE_PORT (3099). GET /health reports ok together with the engine state, and every gateway route exists under both /v1 and /api/v1.

skills.name: Configuration and Environment
skills.description: Environment knobs are read in nova/config.py: DATA/DATABASE_URL, NOVA_REQUIRE_API_KEY, DEFAULT_RPM/TPM/RPD/TPD, key cooldown timings, NOVA_RESPONSE_CACHE, session TTL and upstream timeouts. Defaults never change routing for an untouched deployment; GET /api/admin/meta exposes the UI-relevant ones.
